title: Disciplined Bilevel Programming
abstract: arXiv:2609.00644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bilevel optimization provides a natural modeling language for hierarchical decision problems. However, applying existing numerical solvers usually requires substantial manual analysis and reformulation. In this paper, we introduce disciplined bilevel programming (DBLP), a symbolic framework that allows users to specify and solve optimistic bilevel problems in a high-level, human-readable way that is close to the mathematical formulation. For problems with a disciplined nonlinear upper problem and a convex lower problem satisfying the disciplined parameterized programming rules, DBLP automatically canonicalizes the lower problem into conic form and constructs an equivalent single-level reformulation using the conic Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. We relax the resulting complementarity constraint and use a gap continuation procedure to approximately solve a sequence of smooth nonlinear problems. We implement DBLP in the open-source Python

translated_abstract: 双层优化为分层决策问题提供了一种自然的建模语言。然而，应用现有的数值求解器通常需要大量的人工分析与重新表述。在本文中，我们提出了规范化双层规划（Disciplined Bilevel Programming, DBLP），这是一个符号化框架，允许用户以接近数学表述的高级、人类可读的方式描述并求解乐观双层问题。对于上层问题为规范化非线性问题、下层问题为满足规范化参数化规划规则的凸问题这一类问题，DBLP 会自动将下层问题规范化为锥形式，并利用锥形式的 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker 条件构造等价的单层重述。我们对由此产生的互补性约束进行松弛，并采用间隙延拓方法近似求解一系列光滑非线性问题。DBLP 已在开源 Python 中实现。
tldr: 提出了规范化双层规划（DBLP）符号化框架，用户只需以贴近数学公式的人类可读方式描述乐观双层问题，系统即可自动将凸下层问题转化为锥形式、借助锥 KKT 条件构造等价单层重述，并通过互补松弛与间隙延拓高效近似求解。
en_tdlr: DBLP is a symbolic framework that lets users specify optimistic bilevel problems in a high-level, human-readable way and automatically canonicalizes the convex lower problem into conic form, builds an equivalent single-level reformulation via conic KKT conditions, and approximately solves it through complementarity relaxation and a gap continuation procedure.
